proposal.description: Supervisor's latch_assert input is wired to the debounced SCR read-back instead of strike_counter's own trip latch_out, so the CPLD's strike latch is no longer a hard fault to the FSM
proposal.reason: When strike_counter raises latch_out on the MAX_STRIKES-th hiccup entry and the SCR read-back latch_stat does not (yet) follow, the original forces En low and goes to S_OFF; the mutant finishes the cool-down, returns to S_SS and drives En high again.

proposal.description: switch_supply is driven from the registered pgood_LED indicator copy instead of PGOOD itself, adding a clock to the changeover hand-back
proposal.reason: When PGOOD drops (comparator out of window or leaving S_RUN), switch_supply now deasserts one clock later than PGOOD instead of on the same clock, breaking the immediate hand-back the header requires; assertion is likewise a clock late.

proposal.description: pgood_gen is qualified on soft_start's SS_done ('ramp finished') instead of the supervisor's run_active
proposal.reason: SS_done is registered in soft_start and only clears a clock after the FSM leaves S_RUN, so on a window trip or hard fault PGOOD and switch_supply drop one clock late instead of immediately; qualification also starts one clock before S_RUN is entered.

proposal.description: UVLO debouncer's asymmetry is reversed (fast 200 us assert, slow 1 ms release), the usual 'trip fast, clear slow' rule misapplied where the header wants assert to be the longer qualification
proposal.reason: A UVLO_trig pulse lasting between 200 us and 1 ms now shuts the converter down (En low, Red_LED3 on) where it was rejected before, and every UVLO release, including the one after reset, takes 1 ms instead of 200 us before the converter may start.

proposal.description: The latch read-back debouncer is given the short symmetric SPI glitch-filter length (8 clocks) instead of the fault-flag 1 ms / 200 us qualification
proposal.reason: A latch_stat pulse longer than 160 ns but shorter than 1 ms (switching-node pickup) now forces En low and the FSM to S_OFF, lights Red_LED1 solid, and its release is accepted after 8 clocks instead of 200 us.

proposal.description: fault_arbiter's RUN window is enabled by the qualified PGOOD instead of run_active, so overcurrent in S_RUN is only counted while the rail is in regulation
proposal.reason: In S_RUN before PGOOD has qualified, or once a short has pulled the rail out of window and dropped PGOOD, the RUN window is held cleared and window_trip never fires, so a sustained CP_trig never sends the converter to hiccup: En stays high where it should go low.

proposal.description: reg_file's enable-switch status bit is fed from the gate-driver enable En instead of the debounced switch level
proposal.reason: With the switch on but the converter held off (S_OFF on OTP/UVLO, S_HICCUP, or host-disabled), an SPI read of the status register reports the switch as off; it reports on only while the gate driver is actually enabled.
